findings.evidence: Grep confirms root namespace declarations in Subalgebra/Equalizer.lean:35,47,57; Etale/Equalizer.lean:295,303; Etale/Idempotent.lean:97; Idempotents/BaseChange.lean:66; Idempotents/Refinement.lean:116,136,151,167; Spectrum/Prime/FreeLocus.lean:180; TensorProduct/Pi.lean:68. Their explicit arguments are equivalences, families, idempotent proofs, elements, or algebra maps rather than receivers of the namespaces used; the rubric reserves this exception for receiver dot notation.
findings.fix: Move these declarations under `TauCeti` and update references, or place genuine receiver methods in the namespace of their first explicit argument. Do not retain aliases.
findings.issue: New non-receiver APIs bypass `TauCeti`: `AlgHom.equalizerCongr` and `coe_equalizerCongr_apply`; all three new `FixedPoints` declarations; `Algebra.Etale.of_completeOrthogonalIdempotents`; `Module.Finite.of_completeOrthogonalIdempotents`; `CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.prod_ite`, `ite_mul_prod_ite`, and `notMem_iff_of_one_sub_prod_ite_mem`; `Ideal.Quotient.mk_span_singleton_one_sub_self`; `Module.exists_rankAtStalk_tensorProduct_eq`; and `Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight_map_symm_single`. This makes their canonical names inconsistent with the required namespace policy.

summary: Several new declarations occupy root namespaces without qualifying for the rubric’s dot-notation exception.
